changes: Implemented the CARTO API key now required by their raster basemap service (applies to the CartoDB Dark and CartoDB Positron layers).
Added an "Add contact" button for repeaters, room servers, and companions that adds the contact directly in the MeshCore app via the meshcore:// protocol.
Added support for MapTiler maps (hybrid and outdoor), requiring a separate API key.
Split the basemap switcher into "Tiles" and "Vector" categories, and OpenFreeMap is now always shown in the menu - removed the separate setting to enable it.
Changed the "Esri Satellite" map to "Esri Hybrid" - satellite imagery with boundaries and place names overlaid.
Added a notice for when a previously saved map is unavailable due to a missing API key - in that case, the default map is selected instead.
Improved the reliability of falling back to a backup map after a load error.
Clicking a node on the map now updates the URL to a direct link to it (just like the "Share" button), and once its details are closed, the URL reverts to the current map view.
Updated the frontend msgpackr dependency to version 2.1.0.
Adapted to the upstream data source moving from map.meshcore.dev to map.meshcore.io.
Updated backend dependencies to the latest version.
Added a backend API endpoint for historical network statistics, with daily snapshots saved automatically.
Updated the frontend msgpackr dependency to version 2.0.5.
Updated the MapLibre GL library (OpenFreeMap layer) to version 6.5.0, migrating its loading to ES modules.
Fixed the frequency filter - after switching to "All nodes", some frequencies not used in Poland were incorrectly shown as unchecked instead of checked by default.
Minor SEO fixes. Not relevant to end users.
Updated backend dependencies to the latest version.
Prepared the site for the global MeshCore Profiles map - map.meshcoreprofiles.com.
Implemented i18n.
Other minor fixes and improvements.
Added new tools: distance measurement, route drawing by node names or keys, and terrain/range analysis between two points (elevation profile and approximate line-of-sight visibility).
Added a custom date range and a "Show on map" button to the "New nodes" statistics, which highlights the selected nodes and zooms in on them.
Added close buttons to the settings, statistics, legend and changelog windows.
The search magnifier icon now hides with an animation after clicking the field, and Escape clears the results and removes focus from it.
Other minor visual and animation fixes.
Finished responsive design work. The site now works correctly on mobile devices.
Added vibration on button press (Android).
Published a new API with repeater statistics for meshcorepolska.org.
Other minor fixes and improvements, including SEO.
Added the "Close the filter panel after applying" setting.
Added the "Show OpenFreeMap in the map switcher" setting.
Added new maps: CartoDB Dark, CartoDB Positron, CyclOSM and Humanitarian OSM.
CartoDB Dark is now the default map.
Added a changelog.
Fixed and improved filter functionality.
Fixed some animations.
Redesigned the "i" button in the bottom-right corner of the page.
Other minor visual fixes.
Polish-language interface.
Ability to switch between nodes from Poland and the whole world.
Sharing a selected node or contact via a direct link.
Copying node and contact data to the clipboard.
Poland selected as the default region on first launch.
Data sent in a compact MessagePack format; only nodes from Poland are fetched in the default view.
Searching nodes by name and public key, with keyboard support.
Frontend built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript with no application framework, modern code.
